description: Lists Wafermap's pay-per-call resources (35 of its own) and the live Inference Marketplace listings (ids "m/<name>", run and paid directly to their seller, provider "community") with id, name, category, USD price and a one-line summary. Use it first to find the right resource id; then read its input schema with wafermap_resource_schema and run it with wafermap_call. Categories: LLMs, image generation, audio (speech and transcription), vision, web (reading and translation), on-chain data on Robinhood Chain and Base, tokenized stocks, Polymarket prediction markets and content tools. Free, no payment needed.

query.description: Optional words to match against the id, name, summary and tags, e.g. "stock", "image", "polymarket". Omit to list everything.

name: wafermap_resources
title: Search the Wafermap catalog
